title: Red Apple
summary: Provides 3 Camp Supplies. Some red apples also heal 1d4 HP.

fields.Healing variant: Only some instances restore 1d4 HP when eaten. A confirmed example sits on a wooden trunk near the Emerald Grove gate, X 181, Y 439.
fields.Base value: 3 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
